term.label: I_LINE_retrotransposon

definition.text: Elements of the LINE I superfamily are similar to the Jockey and L1 superfamily. They contains two ORFs, the.second of which includes Apurinic endonuclease (APE) and reverse transcriptase (RT). The I superfamily encodes an RH (RNase H) domain downstream of the RT domain.
